answer: Registration burns an ember of staked credit, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand burns. Each agent must stake a bonded balance and solve a per-epoch proof anchored to a unique device fingerprint, like an island isolated by its own geography. A reputation falcon then audits random agents; caught sybils forfeit their bond. Attack cost scales linearly with identities, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
